## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour or bug fixes have a test (fuzzer finds go in `test/errors.test.ts`)
- [ ] User-visible changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md`; design choices in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] No compression or image libraries added to `src/` (dev dependencies are fine)
